CheckLinksJob
Scans all BibTeX entries in a project and flags entries whose DOI/URL link looks broken, via CheckLinksService.
CheckLinksService
Orchestrates the "Check Links" job: for every BibTexEntry in a project, resolves the link that CitationTable's "Link" column shows (DOI first, URL as a backup — see the frontend CitationTable.jsx) and flags entries whose link looks broken, so the UI can surface a warning next to them.
CitationEdge
A MongoDB document representing a directed "cites" relationship between two BibTexEntrys in the same project, identified by their citeKeys.
CitationEdgeRepository
Mongo repository ("collection") for CitationEdge documents.
CitationEdgesController
Read-only endpoints for the citation graph built by the "Get References"/"Get Citations" jobs (see CitationGraphService): the papers a given entry cites, the papers that cite it, and the entries no configured resolver could fully resolve (see docs/design/OpenAlex-MVP-to-full-tiered-fallback-engine.md).
CitationGraphService
Orchestrates the "Get References" and "Get Citations" jobs: looks up a source BibTexEntry's DOI across a chain of CitationMetadataResolvers (OpenAlex first, then Semantic Scholar, then Crossref), resolves the related works the first successful resolver names, synthesizes+saves a BibTexEntry for each one not already present (deduped by DOI), and records a CitationEdge between the source and each related entry.

ResolvedWork
A minimal, resolver-agnostic projection of a scholarly work, carrying only the fields BibTexSynthesisService needs to synthesize a BibTeX entry, plus enough of its reference/citation graph for CitationGraphService to discover related works without a second round-trip where a resolver's API already hands them over in the same response.
